caption: The drawing depicts a square grid pattern positioned in the center of a plain, off-white background. The grid is composed of many small rectangles and squares, formed by thin, beige and light brown lines that simulate the texture of woven fabric. Alternating squares within the grid are shaded lightly, creating a subtle checkerboard effect. The intersecting horizontal and vertical lines suggest a basket-weave arrangement. The artist’s signature, "Edith Olney," is written in small letters near the bottom right corner of the composition, just beneath the grid. There are no other objects, colors, or elements present in the image.
title: Linen Luncheon Set
